purpose: Defines requirements for mechanically identifying documents in a parallel state during additive development and conveying that to spec consumers so outdated specs are not used as the basis for decisions.
summary: Overview: old spec documents are not rewritten until implementation completes, creating parallel old and new specs
Why a mechanism is needed: parallel state cannot be inferred from content or location, and consumers cannot tell not-delivered from nonexistent
Glossary: parallel state, old spec, spec consumer, implementer
Scope: consumers table (implementation, review, upstream generation, merge) with conveyance status
Out of scope: additive-development criteria, merge procedure, preventing missed markers, mechanisms outside forge
FNC-001: machine-readable identification of parallel state; plans carry no marker
FNC-002: identification result carries state only, not actions
FNC-003: conveyance to each consumer before judgment, including when none exist
FNC-004: old spec description is not the current spec, regardless of contradiction
FNC-005: identification failure must not be treated as not in parallel state
tasks: Designing or implementing additive development (differential feature) handling
Writing requirements or designs marked as temporary feature
Implementing code based on requirements and designs in parallel state
Reviewing artifacts against specs that may be in parallel state
Generating upstream documents (design, plan, requirements, UX/UI) from existing specs
Merging parallel-state documents into old specs
Determining whether a plan belongs to an additive feature
title: REQ-025 差分開発の仕組み 要件定義書
